introHtml: LMRK lanyards offer a reliable, durable option for organizations that need to identify staff, attendees, or students at a glance. From the vibrant Rainbow Lanyard to the eco-friendly 3/4" Recycled Lanyard, LMRK provides a range of styles suitable for conferences, schools, and corporate events. These lanyards are designed to hold badges securely and can be customized with your logo or text using screen printing or dye sublimation. Choose LMRK for consistent quality and bulk availability.
